dct_title_s: Black Hawk County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol ST; form of individual image numbering: ST-1-[number], ST-2-[number], ST-3-[number], ST-4-[number, ST-5-[number, or ST-6-[number]."Date of completion 08-16-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
